## Description

Employs score-based generative diffusion models on continuous-time continuous-state limit order book event streams to synthesize realistic liquidity shock scenarios for algorithmic backtesting.

## Where it may fit

Stress testing HFT execution strategies, training reinforcement learning trading agents under data scarcity.

## Vehicles

High-Frequency Trading Firms, Quantitative Risk Management Groups.

## Required data

High-frequency historical limit order book message logs and execution event timestamps.

## Caveats

Reverse diffusion sampling requires numerical ODE solvers, increasing scenario generation time.
